sentences.en: They think the owner of the house is studying abroad.
sentences.zh: 他们认为房子的所有权人正在国外学习。

sentences.en: The owner of this bar never sells liquor on credit.
sentences.zh: 这家酒吧的主人从不赊酒。

sentences.en: It happened that we met the owner of the flat.
sentences.zh: 碰巧我们遇到了这套公寓的所有者。

senses.zh: 主人, 物主, 所有权人
